hook: Your drone view of Belize shows a perfectly round hole in the ocean.
title: Your Drone Sees a Perfect Hole in the Sea
description:
The Great Blue Hole off Belize is a giant marine sinkhole, about 300 m across, set inside a reef. It formed on land long ago and was flooded as sea levels rose. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Belize #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you dive in? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your drone sees a perfect dark circle in the sea.
scenes.headline: A PERFECT CIRCLE

scenes.narration: It is called the Great Blue Hole.
scenes.headline: THE GREAT BLUE HOLE

scenes.narration: It sits inside a reef, in shallow turquoise water.
scenes.headline: INSIDE A REEF

scenes.narration: It is a sinkhole, flooded by the sea.
scenes.headline: A FLOODED SINKHOLE

scenes.narration: It formed on land, before the ocean rose.
scenes.headline: IT WAS ONCE DRY LAND

scenes.narration: Divers say it is over 120 metres deep.
scenes.headline: OVER 120 M DEEP

scenes.narration: A perfect circle, hiding in the sea.
scenes.headline: A CIRCLE IN THE SEA

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: another place that shouldn't exist.
scenes.headline: NEXT: ANOTHER IMPOSSIBLE PLACE
